sources.snippet: MiniMax M2.5 is a Mixture of Experts (MoE) language model built for state-of-the-art coding, agentic tool use, search, and office work. It was extensively trained with reinforcement learning across hundreds of thousands of real-world environments, enabling it to plan like an architect and generalize across unfamiliar scaffolding and tools.
